samplingFinding: Twenty-seven of forty unseen query pages on twenty previously qualified training domains passed the frozen capture gates, a 67.5% page yield. Twenty-eight attempts captured successfully; one captured page was rejected for exposing only six candidate roots. The remaining twelve attempts were one blocked annotation and eleven navigation or capture errors.
visualValidationFinding: All twenty-seven accepted full-page annotation views were inspected after capture and showed coherent query-result evidence. The 313 frozen roots span mass, volume, count, length, and area. They include explicit per-half-meter and per-meter prices; per-box and per-sheet offers without enough coverage evidence; package-count versus physical-dimension and capacity ambiguity; starting prices, ranges, sales, kits, and accessories; query-adjacent semantic hard negatives; and listings where the correct outcome is abstention because package quantity, coverage, or price binding is absent. Fixed chat and navigation elements remained below the frozen twenty-percent obstruction limit and did not cover the selected evidence.
